passage.text: In 2011, Mr. Brown worked in a big office in Canada.
passage.reading: ɪn ˈtwɛnti ɪˈlɛvən, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈwɜːrkt ɪn ə ˈbɪɡ ˈɔːfɪs ɪn ˈkænədə.

passage.text: He was an accountant, and his salary was good, but he wasn't happy.
passage.reading: hiː wʌz ən əˈkaʊntənt, ənd hɪz ˈsæləri wʌz ˈɡʊd, bʌt hiː ˈwʌzənt ˈhæpi.

passage.text: His boss was never happy, and Mr. Brown worked long hours every day.
passage.reading: hɪz ˈbɔːs wʌz ˈnɛvər ˈhæpi, ənd ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn ˈwɜːrkt ˌlɔːŋ ˈaʊərz ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: One day, he read about jobs for English teachers in Thailand.
passage.reading: ˈwʌn ˈdeɪ, hiː ˈrɛd əˈbaʊt ˈdʒɑːbz fər ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈtiːtʃərz ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

passage.text: He thought about it for a long time.
passage.reading: hiː ˈθɔːt əˈbaʊt ɪt fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: Then he made a big decision: he quit his job and moved to Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn hiː ˈmeɪd ə ˈbɪɡ dɪˈsɪʒən: hiː ˈkwɪt hɪz ˈdʒɑːb ənd ˈmuːvd tə ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: Now he teaches English at a university, and he loves his students.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ hiː ˈtiːtʃɪz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ət ə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti, ənd hiː ˈlʌvz hɪz ˈstuːdənts.

passage.text: It was the best decision for him!
passage.reading: ɪt wʌz ðə ˈbɛst dɪˈsɪʒən fər hɪm!
